reading.body:
Iron Mountain Data Centers AZS-1 is a Scottsdale facility positioned 22 kilometers north of the operator's Phoenix campus. The campus has no published power specification, IT load capacity, or cooling capacity in the operator's spec page, and therefore cannot be sized against AI infrastructure benchmarks.

Arizona has 56 mapped data center facilities of which only 4 publish power specifications totaling 512 MW. AZS-1 does not appear in that published total, placing it outside the state's disclosed capacity footprint even as a facility it is geographically and operationally tied to one of the state's operators.

Without published specifications, this campus cannot be evaluated as a binding constraint on AI scaling or ranked among sites that matter to the decision to locate AI workloads. The absence of a published figure suggests either that the facility is not marketed for hyperscale AI, or that Iron Mountain has not disclosed its capacity for this location.
